official_source: Oracle Health Multi-Tenant Domains (Doc ID G11840-01) + V500 DA_* Metadata

environments.name: CommunityWorks
environments.tenancy_model: Multi-Tenant Shared Millennium Domain (parent domain shared across community & critical-access hospitals)
environments.target_care_settings: Community hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals (CAHs), rural health clinics, acute inpatient, ED (FirstNet), surgery (SurgiNet)
environments.custom_ccl_access: Restricted / Prohibited for tenants (shared RDBMS governance prevents tenant-authored CCL scripts from degrading peer hospitals)
environments.primary_authoring_surface: Discern Analytics 2.0 (DA2) Domain Query Builder + BIRT 4.4.2 Designer (.rptdesign XML)
environments.cross_domain_join_strategy: Multi-dataset BIRT Join Data Set on Enc Id (ENCNTR_ID) or FIN (Enc Encounter Number)

environments.name: Continuum
environments.tenancy_model: Multi-Tenant Shared Millennium Domain (parent domain shared across post-acute, rehab, and behavioral health organizations)
environments.target_care_settings: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRF), Long-Term Care (LTC), Skilled Nursing, Outpatient Rehab (PT/OT/SLP), Behavioral Health
environments.custom_ccl_access: Restricted / Prohibited for tenants (same multi-tenant shared-domain governance as CommunityWorks; standard reports use CWC/CWF DA2 domains)
environments.primary_authoring_surface: Discern Analytics 2.0 (DA2) Domain Query Builder + BIRT 4.4.2 Designer (.rptdesign XML)
environments.cross_domain_join_strategy: Multi-dataset BIRT Join Data Set on Enc Id / FIN; therapy minutes & assessments pulled via Clinical Events (CE) + Charges (Chg)
environments.clinical_workflow_distinctions: Long length-of-stay census (Enc Admit Dt Tm <= cutoff AND Enc Disch Dt Tm IS NULL), therapy treatment minutes & CPT charges, FIM/CARE/IRF-PAI functional scores in CLINICAL_EVENT, recurring outpatient therapy series (SCH_APPT / SCH_EVENT)

environments.name: Standalone / Remote Hosted (RHO) / Dedicated Single-Tenant
environments.tenancy_model: Single-Tenant Dedicated Millennium Domain (1 health system per Millennium instance)
environments.target_care_settings: Large IDNs, academic medical centers, multi-hospital enterprise health systems
environments.custom_ccl_access: Full DVDev / Discern Explorer access (CREATE PROGRAM, custom .prg scripts, custom record structures, direct uar_get_code_* calls)
environments.primary_authoring_surface: CCL (.prg) + Discern Explorer + DA2 Custom Domains + BIRT with com.cerner.discern.connectivity.oda + Direct Oracle RDBMS / HealtheIntent ODS v1 feeds
environments.cross_domain_join_strategy: Direct SQL/CCL joins across V500 tables in a single query or custom DA_BUS_VIEW / DA_TABLE_RELTN extension
environments.data_isolation_mechanism: Dedicated V500 database instance; optional internal logical domains for M&A affiliates
